title: DICOMtoAWSHealthcare: a verifiable DICOM de-identification pipeline for research imaging data
description:
Python pipeline that reads DICOM files (including compressed multi-frame), de-identifies them with a subset of the DICOM PS3.15 Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile, keyed HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymisation, per-patient date shifting and deterministic UID remapping, independently re-scans every output for residual identifiers, quarantines files with burned-in text risk, and records every decision in a relational database with an audit log.

All bundled data are synthetic or public. This release is not clinically validated and makes no claim of regulatory compliance.
